response.overview: You can communicate on an AIDA cruise by connecting to the ship's local Wi-Fi and using the AIDA Official Website app for onboard messaging and digital services.  Onboard App and Messaging AIDA App: Download the app before you board or connect to the free local ship Wi-Fi once onboard. It includes a complimentary or low-cost guest chat feature to message other passengers while on the ship. Internet Packages: Purchase an AIDA Wi-Fi plan (such as Social, Value, or Premium) if you want to use external apps like WhatsApp, iMessage, or check your regular email.  Traditional and Alternative Options Stateroom Telephones: Use the cabin phones to make free cabin-to-cabin calls to other guests on the ship, Contact or Call +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK) Cellular at Sea: Cellular roaming is available via maritime networks when far out at sea, though it can incur high roaming charges from your home mobile carrier.
